headline: Traders Place Leveraged Bets on Anthropic IPO Using Crypto Contracts
summary: Traders are placing leveraged bets on a potential Anthropic initial public offering using crypto contracts, with Trade.xyz’s new ANT contract dropping about 20% in its first hour on Hyperliquid.
why: Anthropic is a prominent artificial intelligence startup developing foundational models, attracting significant speculative interest ahead of any public market debut.
